content.comment_body: Hello experts, is there a way to secure the code in [product_name] against unauthorized modifications?
Hi [user_name], you can set a password for your program file. Go to File > Properties > Parameter > Program Password. This should help with securing your code.
Dear [user_name], so the password setting is done offline and saved in your local project. When you download the project to the device, the password is applied to the module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about protecting their code on [product_name] devices from unauthorized changes. The conversation clarifies that password protection can be applied to the program file and transferred to the hardware during the download process. It is noted that new users may find the procedure unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for an easy and secure method to safeguard their program code on [product_name] devices, making sure only authorized individuals can modify the code.
